name: Destroy Island
body:
School transmutation; Level Epic (Spellcraft DC 38)

CASTING

Casting Time 65 days
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range one mile
Area 30,000 ft.
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You can literally sink a small island back into the sea. The island destroyed by this spell can be up to 30,000 square feet. The island disappears back into the ocean over a period of one minute.
